hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Saturn Omnichain that defines pool configuration constants (3000 bps fee, 60 tick spacing) and delegates liquidity bootstrapping to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op; all swap-related callbacks are absent or no-ops, so swap behavior is fully vanilla.
